resources.title: Working Through Anxiety
resources.description: A 14-minute guided meditation and visualization set to original music, designed to help listeners move through anxiety and fear by connecting with a sense of divine support. It's well suited for coaches, teachers, or anyone seeking a calming tool they can also share with clients or students. It streams free on Insight Timer with no subscription required.

resources.title: Guided Bedtime Body Scan Meditation For Sleep And Anxiety
resources.description: A gentle, voice-guided body scan practice designed to ease the body into deep relaxation before sleep, using crystal singing bowls alongside spoken guidance to calm anxiety.
